## 5. Exclusion Rules

- **Healing windows** (label='healing'): excluded from classifier evaluation
- **Unlabelled windows** (label='unlabeled' or label=''): excluded from classifier evaluation
- **Oct 3 raw data**: kept unlabelled until collection conditions verified by original collector

## 6. Train/Val/Test Separation Enforcement

- **Training**: model fitting and feature preprocessing (scalers fitted here only)
- **Validation**: hyperparameter selection, threshold calibration, model selection
- **Final test**: one-time evaluation of frozen pipeline. No test-set information may influence model or threshold selection.
